bio.text: Rick Crawford has served in the U.S. House of Representatives for Arkansas's First District since running for Congress in 2010, and chairs the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence.
He served four years in the U.S. Army as an Explosive Ordnance Disposal Technician, reaching the rank of Sergeant.
He graduated from Arkansas State University in 1996 with a degree in Agriculture Business and Economics and lives in Jonesboro.
